p: sentence come forth from thy presence: The vengeance that you will show against my enemies.
proved mine heart: When your Spirit examined my conscience.
mouth shall not transgress: I was innocent toward my enemy both in deed and thought.
word of thy lips I have: Though the wicked provoked me to do evil for evil, yet your word kept me back.
for thou wilt hear me: He was assured that God would not refuse his request.
rise up against them: For all rebel against you, who trouble your Church.
me about: For their cruelty cannot be satisfied but with my death.
fat: They are puffed up with pride, as the stomach that is choked with fat.
portion in this life: And not feel the pain that God's children often do.
in righteousness: This is the full happiness, comforting against all assaults to have the face of God and favourable countenance opened to us.
awake: And am delivered out of my great troubles.
